verdicts.explanation: The FIXME admits the bastion security group was opened to the world and never locked down; this is a live exposure, not a note.
verdicts.suggested_fix: Restrict cidr_blocks to the office/VPN ranges (or use SSM Session Manager and drop port 22), then remove the FIXME.

new_issues.title: SSH (port 22) open to the entire internet
new_issues.explanation: Ingress on 22/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0 exposes the bastion to internet-wide SSH brute forcing and any OpenSSH vulnerability.
new_issues.suggested_fix: Replace 0.0.0.0/0 with a variable listing trusted CIDRs, or remove the ingress rule and use AWS SSM Session Manager.
